learningGoals: Understand the quantity each number represents. 🍎
Match the correct written number to a group of objects. 🧩
Develop basic number sense through everyday items. 🌟
teachingTips: Encourage counting out loud during everyday tasks, like setting the table or putting away toys. 🍽️
Use real fruits, like mangoes or grapes, to make counting tangible, fun, and tasty! 🥭
Point out numbers in your environment, such as on clocks, phones, or house doors to build familiarity. 🚪
Always praise their effort and make counting feel like a game to build their math confidence. 💖

funActivities.title: Mango Counting Game 🥭
funActivities.description: Use pieces of chopped mango or other small snacks. Ask your child to give you exactly 3 pieces, then 5 pieces, and count them together!

funActivities.title: Nature Scavenger Hunt 🍃
funActivities.description: Go for a walk and ask your child to find 1 big rock, 2 yellow leaves, 3 twigs, and so on up to 9. Count the treasures at home!

funActivities.title: Match the Toys 🧸
funActivities.description: Write numbers 1 to 9 on pieces of paper. Ask your child to place the correct number of small toys or blocks next to each number card.
